optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Demand Forecasting Analyst, Small Kitchen Appliances
professionalSummary: Experienced demand forecaster with a proven track record of building and maintaining weekly SKU-level forecasts for over 1,100 products using Python, including statistical and machine learning models. Demonstrated ability to measure forecast accuracy with MAPE and bias, incorporate retailer promotion calendars and price changes, present consolidated demand views to senior planners, and rigorously log model changes in a model register.
experienceHighlights: Built and ran a weekly SKU-level forecast for about 1,100 active products using Python (statsmodels and LightGBM), refreshed every Monday from the order-history warehouse at Halden Housewares.
Published a monthly forecast‑accuracy report giving MAPE and bias by product family and by retailer, used as the accuracy input to the S&OP cycle.
Met the key‑account team each fortnight to load retailer promotion calendars and planned price changes into the forecast as event features, keeping a promotion log next to each forecast run.
Prepared the demand slides for the monthly S&OP meeting and answered the plant planners' questions on the forecast at two meetings while the demand planning manager was on leave.
Logged each model change (new features, retraining schedule, hyper‑parameter updates) in the analytics model register with the back‑test results attached.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Work sample: a model‑register entry for the March retraining of the blender‑category model, listing the feature changes, a 26‑week back‑test table of MAPE and bias by retailer, and the date the reviewing analyst approved the change.
skills: Python (statsmodels, LightGBM), statistical forecasting, MAPE, bias, promotion calendar integration, S&OP reporting, model register documentation
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample establish the candidate’s experience with weekly SKU‑level forecasting, accuracy reporting, promotion calendar integration, S&OP presentation, and model register logging. They do not provide evidence of the candidate’s performance in a production environment, nor do they confirm the candidate’s role in a larger organization beyond Halden Housewares.
